title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
summary: Find the length of the longest stretch of a string in which no character appears twice.

tests.explain: "cdbefg" (indices 2 to 7) has no repeats. Any longer substring would contain both b's.
Every substring longer than one character repeats z.
The empty string has no characters, so the answer is 0.

hints: Checking every substring is O(n²) substrings, each checked in O(n). The answer is a contiguous stretch: think window.
Grow a window to the right one character at a time, keeping the characters it contains in a Set.
When the new character is already in the window, move left forward (removing characters from the set) until the old copy is gone. Record right - left + 1 after every step.

complexity.time: O(n): each character enters and leaves the window at most once
complexity.space: O(k): the set holds at most one copy of each distinct character
